description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaburugamuwa, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No.820069 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and owner details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership and land title settlements, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
